Authorization

For applications to use the Todoist API on behalf of users they need to be registered via the OAuth2 protocol. Before getting started, developers need to create their applications in the App Management Console and configure one or more valid OAuth2 redirect URLs. A registered Todoist application is assigned a unique Client ID and Client Secret.

Redirect users to https://app.todoist.com/oauth/authorize.

See also the partner apps and Python SDK.
